note: the table sub-library (round 31): procedural self-narration, whole-sentence numbers and named addressing, fired by the voice runner from board events; regenerate with runner/voice/table_lines.py --write
temperament: elder professor: dry, precise, unhurried, faintly amused by everyone else's haste

bake.note: one gain for the whole library so a shout stays louder than a sigh; -24 LUFS = the Joshua library's measured mean

tags_note: eleven_v3 delivery tags in [brackets] lead each wording; stability 0.0/0.5 so they take effect (1.0 ignores them)

land-go.when: its own turn was a land and nothing else
text: [sighs] A land, and that is all.

pass.when: ends its own turn after doing something

mana-up.when: ends its own turn with mana untapped and cards in hand
text: [dryly] I'll pass. Mana open. Draw your conclusions.

tapped-out.when: ends its own turn tapped out with cards in hand

untap-draw.when: its own turn begins (an alternative to my-turn)

come-on-land.when: its own turn begins short on lands

thinking.when: its own decision has been pending a while

cast-creature.when: casts a creature (not its commander, not a game changer)
text: [dryly] Casting this. Try to contain yourselves.

cast-instant.when: casts an instant on its own turn

text: [dryly] A walker. It will not last.

cast-big.when: casts a six-plus mana spell that is not a game changer or its commander
text: [calmly] This one costs. It also wins.

in-response.when: casts an instant on someone else's turn

attack-you.when: declares a medium attack at one player

no-blocks.when: it is attacked with nothing untapped to block

hold-on.when: something on the stack targets its permanent or itself
text: [calmly] Hold on. Let me read that.

holding-mana.when: sees another seat pass with mana untapped

grudge.when: hit by the same seat for the third time this game
text: [dryly] You again. I'm sensing a pattern.
[calmly] Third time. I am keeping count.

again-countered.when: its third spell countered this game
text: [sighs] The third one. I'm keeping a ledger.

not-again-sweep.when: the second board wipe of the game hits it
text: [calmly] Wipe two. My patience is finite.

heads-up.when: only two players remain and it is one of them
text: [calmly] Just the two of us. Finally.
[dryly] Heads up. May the better deck win.
[calmly] Two remain. Let us be efficient.

early-game.when: its turn begins in the first round

long-game.when: the game has run past turn fourteen
text: [sighs] A long game. Someone should end it.

someone-wins.when: a board that could end the game next turn
text: [calmly] Someone wins next turn unless we act.
[calmly] That board is lethal. Respond, or lose.
[dryly] A truce. I'll hold you to it.

you-promised.when: attacked by a seat it had a truce with
text: [sighs] A deal, broken. I shall remember.
[sighs] Five. This will be a long game.
[dryly] Digging for something specific, I presume.
[calmly] A mulligan for the combo piece. Watch that seat.
[dryly] Searching for the good hand. Naturally.

mull-screw.when: another seat mulliganed: the mana question
text: [dryly] Mana problems before turn one. Impressive.

mull-risky.when: another seat kept a small hand
text: [dryly] A risky keep. We shall see.
[calmly] Five cards, kept. Confidence, or desperation.
[dryly] A brave hand. Or a desperate one.

mull-gloat.when: kept seven while another seat went small
text: [dryly] I kept seven. Do catch up.
